description: This file defines the MPSHooks struct implementing the MPSHooksInterface for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) in the PyTorch framework. It provides function declarations for initializing and managing MPS devices, streams, allocators, events, and profiling tools, specifically tailored for macOS or newer versions.

classes.name: MPSHooks
classes.description: Implementation of the MPSHooksInterface, providing concrete methods for managing Metal Performance Shaders resources and operations on macOS devices.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes MPS hooks, potentially setting up necessary resources for MPS operations.

methods.name: hasMPS
methods.description: Checks if MPS is available on the current device.

methods.name: isOnMacOSorNewer
methods.description: Determines if the current OS is macOS or a newer version based on specified major and minor version numbers.

methods.name: getDeviceFromPtr
methods.description: Retrieves the device associated with a given pointer.

methods.name: getDefaultGenerator
methods.description: Returns the default random number generator for the given device.

methods.name: getNewGenerator
methods.description: Creates and returns a new generator for the given device.

methods.name: deviceSynchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the device, ensuring all preceding commands have completed.

methods.name: commitStream
methods.description: Commits the current command stream.

methods.name: getCommandBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the current command buffer.

methods.name: getDispatchQueue
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the dispatch queue.

methods.name: getMPSDeviceAllocator
methods.description: Returns the allocator used for MPS device memory.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Empties the internal cache of MPS resources.

methods.name: getCurrentAllocatedMemory
methods.description: Returns the amount of currently allocated MPS memory.

methods.name: getDriverAllocatedMemory
methods.description: Returns the amount of driver-allocated memory.

methods.name: getRecommendedMaxMemory
methods.description: Provides an estimate of the maximum recommended memory to allocate.

methods.name: setMemoryFraction
methods.description: Sets the fraction of memory to be used.

methods.name: isPinnedPtr
methods.description: Checks if a pointer is using pinned memory.

methods.name: getPinnedMemoryAllocator
methods.description: Returns the allocator for pinned memory.

methods.name: profilerStartTrace
methods.description: Starts profiling trace for MPS.

methods.name: profilerStopTrace
methods.description: Stops profiling trace for MPS.

methods.name: acquireEvent
methods.description: Creates and acquires a new MPSEvent, optionally with timing enabled.

methods.name: releaseEvent
methods.description: Releases the specified MPSEvent.

methods.name: recordEvent
methods.description: Records the specified MPSEvent.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for the specified MPSEvent to complete.

methods.name: synchronizeEvent
methods.description: Synchronizes and waits for the given MPSEvent.

methods.name: queryEvent
methods.description: Queries the status of an MPSEvent.

methods.name: elapsedTimeOfEvents
methods.description: Calculates and returns the elapsed time between two MPSEvents.
